newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST - Spanish '97 GDP to grow 2.1/2.3 pct - bank.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Spanish '97 GDP to grow 2.1/2.3 pct - bank.

text.p: Catalonia's savings bank, Caja de Cataluna, said on Wednesday that Spanish gross domestic product should grow between 2.3 percent and 2.1 percent this year.
"These same expectations of a moderate expansion (for 1996) are valid for 1997 with an expected GDP growth between 2.1 and 2.3 percent," Caja de Cataluna wrote in a note to clients.
Government estimates are for real GDP growth of around 3.0 percent this year, up from 2.3 percent in 1996.
In the third quarter of 1996, the latest available data, Spanish GDP grew 2.2 percent year-on-year.
